job.jdText: Our team sits at the center of how Rubrik goes to market. We own the quote-to-cash experience for Sales, Deal Desk, and Finance, ensuring reps and partners can quote and order quickly and accurately, anywhere in the world. We work with Sales Ops, Deal Desk, Finance, Supply Chain, and our distributor partners to turn complex order and pricing scenarios into clear, repeatable processes. We value clear thinking, ownership, and a bias for making the field's job easier. If you thrive under deadline pressure, enjoy unblocking deals, and like building the processes that keep a global distribution model running smoothly this could be a great fit. About the role: The Manager, WW Distribution is the operational link between Rubrik's sales and channel teams and our global distributors. You will serve as the go-to resource for international order and quoting questions, own distributor escalations, and keep pricing information current as hardware costs move. This role is central to closing deals at month and quarter end and to scaling Rubrik's distribution processes as the business grows. This role works closely with Engineering Managers, software engineering, Security, and fellow infrastructure engineers to drive scalable, reliable, and secure platform solutions and is expected to clarify ambiguous problems, lead technical design efforts, and elevate engineering standards across the Infrastructure pillar. Success in this role is measured not only by the delivery of high-quality systems but also by the ability to create technical leverage, strengthen reliability, and increase the organization's execution capacity. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Â Be accountable for the technical health, scalability, and long-term sustainability of a defined infrastructure domain or platform area. Lead complex, multi-cycle infrastructure initiatives with end-to-end ownership â from problem framing and architecture design through to measurable delivery and stabilization. Design robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure architectures and implementation plans that reduce operational risk and improve platform performance. Break down ambiguous or loosely defined infrastructure challenges into clear technical strategies with explicit trade-offs, and communicate these effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and cross-functional teams to align infrastructure work with business priorities and engineering roadmaps. Improve platform reliability by proactively identifying systemic risks, technical debt, and architectural bottlenecks within the domain and drive remediation before they impact teams or customers. Contribute hands-on to infrastructure code and configuration, delivering high-quality, secure, well-structured, and maintainable work (Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, platform automation). Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code practices, and platform automation standards, pushing for improvements that benefit teams beyond your immediate scope. Apply and advocate for cloud infrastructure best practices (primarily AWS), covering cost efficiency, scalability, security compliance, and operational excellence across your domain. Partner with software engineering, security, and QA teams to ensure infrastructure considerations are embedded early in the development lifecycle and architectural decisions. Drive security posture improvements within your domain using cloud security and vulnerability management tools (such as Aikido), moving the team from reactive remediation toward proactive risk reduction. Improve monitoring, observability, and incident response practices within your domain â contributing to better detection, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation. Raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews, documentation, and technical guidance. Mentor mid-level and senior engineers across the Infrastructure pillar, supporting their growth toward greater technical ownership. Support production stability by actively participating in debugging, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation efforts.
